items.text: **A scheduler turn and a finished child do not scan every parked task or sibling** (`crates/nvs-host/src/scheduler.rs:977`), per `data/gaps/nvs-host/a-scheduler-turn-scans-every-parked-task.json`: `run()` collects `doomed` over the whole `parked` map on every reactor wake; `retire` and `detach` (`crates/nvs-host/src/scheduler.rs:422`) `retain` over the parent's children; `Drop for Waiter` (`crates/nvs-host/src/channel.rs:183`) is a `position` over the queue. Ladders `scheduler/parked.nvs` and `scheduler/fan-out.nvs`, flat per task. Rule: AGENTS.md priority ordering.

**A channel send finds its own waiters without scanning the core's** (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/channel.rs:285`), per `data/gaps/nvs-stdlib/a-channel-send-scans-every-waiter-on-the-core.json`: a map from channel to its waiters and a ticket-keyed slab. Ladder `scheduler/waiters.nvs`. Rule: AGENTS.md priority ordering.
